description: This is a shell script for managing the database of a sports telecast platform. It includes functions for checking database connectivity, running SQL scripts, managing migrations, resetting the database, showing status, backing up, and displaying help. The script interacts directly with a PostgreSQL database using command-line tools and contains configuration parameters for database connection, migration scripts, and output formatting.

methods.name: print_status
methods.description: Prints informational messages in green color.

methods.name: print_warning
methods.description: Prints warning messages in yellow color.

methods.name: print_error
methods.description: Prints error messages in red color.

methods.name: check_postgres
methods.description: Checks whether PostgreSQL is accessible with current configuration.

methods.name: run_sql_file
methods.description: Executes a given SQL file using psql.

methods.name: create_migration_table
methods.description: Creates a table to track applied migrations.

methods.name: is_migration_executed
methods.description: Checks if a specific migration has already been applied.

methods.name: record_migration
methods.description: Records the execution of a migration, success or failure.

methods.name: run_migrations
methods.description: Runs all pending migration scripts in order.

methods.name: reset_database
methods.description: Drops all tables and types to reset the database, with confirmation.

methods.name: show_status
methods.description: Displays current database status, including tables and migration history.

methods.name: backup_database
methods.description: Creates a backup of the database using pg_dump.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage information and environment variables.
